speaker: Doctor
text:
I need to clarify the timeline of your symptoms; when did your fatigue, night sweats, and weight loss first begin? Additionally, have you experienced any fever or changes in bowel habits alongside your abdominal pain?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count (CBC), Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel (CMP), Erythrocyte_Sedimentation_Rate (ESR), Lactate_Dehydrogenase (LDH).
REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: COMPLETE_BLOOD_COUNT: WBC: Elevated, Hemoglobin: Slightly Decreased, Platelets: Normal; LACTATE_DEHYDROGENASE: Elevated; COMPREHENSIVE_METABOLIC_PANEL: NORMAL READINGS; ERYTHROCYTE_SEDIMENTATION_RATE: NORMAL READINGS; CHEST_X-RAY: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Patient
text: I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (specifically Hodgkin Lymphoma given supraclavicular nodes and "B symptoms").

I understand your concern, but accurate diagnosis requires ruling out other causes like tuberculosis or metastatic cancer; the test results I requested will confirm the specific pathology. Please remain calm while we await those critical findings.
